items.source: Convert JsonNodes containing JSON Patch to/from Patch objects.
items.translation: 将包含 JSON Patch 的JsonNode与Patch对象之间进行转换。

items.source: A strategy interface for producing Patch instances from a patch document representation (such as JSON Patch) and rendering a Patch to a patch document representation.
items.translation: 用于从补丁文档表示（例如 JSON Patch）生成 Patch 实例的策略接口，以及将 Patch 渲染为补丁文档表示。

items.source: Contextual mapping for he translation of JSON Pointer segments into property references on persistent types.
items.translation: 用于将 JSON Pointer 段映射到持久化类型属性引用的上下文映射。

items.source: Exception thrown if an error occurs in the course of applying a Patch.
items.translation: 如果在应用补丁过程中发生错误，将抛出异常。

items.source: Abstract base class representing and providing support methods for patch operations.
items.translation: 表示补丁操作并提供支持方法的抽象基类。
